latest.scope: Synthetic samples only; fixed expectations from official iztro sample and civil-time standards, not personality or predictive validity.

results.name: Fixed Shanghai standard-time conversion
Historical Shanghai daylight saving in 1988
New York spring gap rejects instead of silently changing the clock
New York repeated local time requires explicit confirmation
Both explicit New York fold choices map to their known UTC instants
Quarter-hour zone is not rounded to an hour
Kiritimati UTC+14 crosses the year before Chinese-time conversion
Gregorian leap-year validation rejects 1900-02-29 and accepts 2000-02-29
Missing clock, invalid IANA name and out-of-range coordinates reject
Archived resolved UTC remains authoritative for reproducibility
Official iztro 2000-08-16 early-Yin female sample
Equivalent New York and Shanghai birth instants produce the same Zi Wei chart
Early and late Zi and the 11:00 branch boundary are preserved
Zi Wei result is a stable JSON snapshot with fixed engine and rules
